content:
anika: Heads-up — we’re planning to roll the retention policy update next Tue. Need a concise, timeboxed playbook for vuln triage requests that need extended SIEM exports + KMS unwraps. Who owns approvals and the ticket template?

bharat: +1. We get asked for extended windows a lot during triage. Can we standardize: request fields, approver ladder, and automated expiry?
dylan: We have the JIT unwrap flow for CMKs but SIEM exports stop at 90d by default. For forensics we sometimes need 180d. We should avoid ad-hoc Slack asks.

elaine: I can draft a doc. Questions: approval matrix proposal — security-oncall for <=14d, seclead/CISO for >14d, legal if PD involved. Thoughts?

anika: That sounds reasonable. Also need a temp RBAC role so analysts can run exports without getting permanent privileges. Timebound assume-role + strict scope.

security-oncall: I can approve up to 14d requests. Requirements: ticket with justification, scoped list of principals, export query, start/end timestamps, and an automated audit entry when the key is unwrapped. Also prefer masked exports unless full raw is necessary.

bharat: Suggested ticket template (to include in docs):
```json
{
  "requester": "<name>",
  "vuln_id": "<ISSUE-1234>",
  "reason": "forensic triage / exploit validation",
  "data_scope": "indices/streams/fields",
  "start_ts": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "end_ts": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "kms_cmk_id": "arn:aws:kms:...",
  "principals": ["user:a@example.com"],
  "masking_delta": "fields to scrub",
  "approval_chain": "security-oncall -> seclead if >14d -> legal if PD",
  "auto_delete_on": "YYYY-MM-DD"
}
```
ops-bot: New ticket created (mock): SEC-4578 — use the template to open a real request.

dylan: Note on KMS rotation: if CMK rotation occurs during the retention window we must snapshot/export before rotation or ensure unwrap path. Add a fallback: pre-rotation export + record of wrapped key IDs.

elaine: Also: DPIA/legal check if EU PII is within scope. We'll need justification, minimal dataset, and redaction rules. I’ll loop in legal when draft is ready.

anika: Quick checklist to include in playbook: 1) Is data PII? 2) Minimal slices only? 3) Mask where possible? 4) Timebox with auto-delete? 5) Audit log present for unwrap and export? :white_check_mark:

security-oncall: Add severity threshold too — require this process for any vuln triage request tied to vulnerabilities rated "critical" or "high". Log the approval in the central audit stream.

bharat: For RBAC implementation idea: create an AWS role `forensic-siem-read-temp` with `sts:AssumeRole` scoped by tag `ttl` and `aws:RequestTag` conditions, and a maximum session duration policy. Eng-iam review required.

dylan: Ops side: add infra alerts if exported payload > 10GB or if export extension is attempted. Auto-revoke if extension not approved within 12h.

elaine: I’ll draft the playbook and put it in the security docs repo under `playbooks/siem-retention-forensics.md`. Will ping legal and eng-iam for review. Expect draft by EOD. :rocket:

anika: Thanks all — tagging @dylan @bharat @elaine for follow-ups.
